newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady amid thin enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady amid thin enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunkers market was steady on Friday with few enquiries seen ahead of the weekend, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was opened with offers between $123-$125 a tonne by majors, with independents indicating slightly lower. Majors started offers of 380 cst at $120-$121.
Traders said they were feeling the pinch of competitive prices from Taiwan and South Korea as Singapore levels remained supported by high cargo values.
